rationale: The March 31, 2026 schedule reports total investments at fair value of 35,500.450 million and 185.4% of net assets. The balance sheet reports net assets of 19,147.147 million; 35,500.450 / 19,147.147 * 100 = 185.405%, which rounds to the reported 185.4%. Thus the reported percentage is correct and F23 fired because the extracted fair-value total of 37,223.203 million is an overstated anchor, exceeding the filing total by 1,722.753 million. The permitted source views do not safely localize that excess to a single row.
